name: launch-app-arguments
description: launchApp with arguments reaches the driver with them, and a repeat launch carrying arguments is not skipped.
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: launch arguments
env: {}
---
- launchApp:
    arguments:
      route: /focus
      retries: 3
- launchApp:
    arguments:
      route: /focus
      retries: 3
